description: Lynx Platform Adapter — enable Lynx apps to use Pulsar haptic presets, pattern composer, and settings via Lynx Native Modules, reusing the existing iOS Swift and Android Kotlin SDKs

userStories.title: Verify synchronous return values work in Lynx Native Modules
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to confirm that Lynx Native Module methods can return values synchronously (number, boolean) since parsePattern() and hapticSupport() rely on this.
acceptanceCriteria: Create a minimal test Lynx Native Module on Android with a method returning Int/Double
Create a minimal test Lynx Native Module on iOS with a method returning NSNumber
Document how to verify JS receives the return value on both platforms

If synchronous returns are NOT supported, document a callback-based fallback design: parsePattern(data, callback) where callback receives patternId, and hapticSupport(callback) where callback receives the level
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is a blocking validation. If sync returns don't work, US-003 and US-006 interfaces change to use callbacks for hapticSupport() and parsePattern(). Write the test modules in a lynx/lynx-pulsar/test-sync-returns/ throwaway directory.

userStories.title: TypeScript NativeModule interface and enums
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer, I need a TypeScript interface that declares the PulsarModule on NativeModules so I can call haptic methods from JS.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/NativePulsar.ts with declare let NativeModules typing for PulsarModule

Interface exposes Pulsar methods: play(name: string), enableHaptics(state: boolean), enableSound(state: boolean), enableCache(state: boolean), clearCache(), preloadPresets(names: string[]), stopHaptics(), shutDownEngine(), hapticSupport(): number, forceHapticsSupportLevel(level: number), enableImpulseCompositionMode(state: boolean), setRealtimeComposerStrategy(strategy: number)
Interface exposes PatternComposer methods: parsePattern(data: object): number, patternPlay(id: number), patternStop(id: number), patternRelease(id: number)
Export HapticSupport enum with values NO_SUPPORT=0 through ADVANCED_SUPPORT=4
Export RealtimeComposerStrategy enum with values ENVELOPE=0 through ENVELOPE_WITH_DISCRETE_PRIMITIVES=3
Export default as NativeModules.PulsarModule
No imports from react-native — only Lynx globals
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/NativeRNPulsar.ts for the full method list. Adapt TurboModule pattern to Lynx NativeModules global. Method names drop the Pulsar_/RealtimeComposer_/PatternComposer_ prefixes used in the RN version since Lynx methodLookup handles the mapping.

userStories.title: Types and Pattern definitions
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer, I need shared type definitions for Pattern, PatternComposer, and related types.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/types.ts with Pattern type: { discretePattern: { time: number, amplitude: number, frequency: number }[], continuousPattern: { amplitude: { time: number, value: number }[], frequency: { time: number, value: number }[] } }
Export PatternComposer type with play(), stop(), parse(pattern), isParsed() methods
Export AdaptivePresetConfig as (() => void) | Pattern
Export AdaptivePreset as { ios: AdaptivePresetConfig, android: AdaptivePresetConfig, lynx?: AdaptivePresetConfig }
Export AdaptiveHaptics as { play: () => void }
Types match react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/types.ts with the addition of the lynx field on AdaptivePreset
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/types.ts. Nearly identical, just adds optional lynx field to AdaptivePreset.

userStories.title: Presets API
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer, I want to call Presets.dogBark() to trigger a haptic preset, matching the React Native API.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/Presets.ts exporting a default object with all preset functions
Each preset function calls Pulsar.play(presetName) where Pulsar is the imported NativePulsar default export
No 'worklet' directives anywhere in the file
System presets included under System namespace: impactLight, impactMedium, impactHeavy, impactSoft, impactRigid, notificationSuccess, notificationWarning, notificationError, selection
Android-specific system presets under System.Android namespace: effectClick, effectDoubleClick, effectTick, effectHeavyClick, primitiveClick, primitiveLowTick, etc. (all entries from RN Presets.ts)
All 150+ custom presets included: afterglow through zipper (match CODEGEN section of RN Presets.ts)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: This is mechanical translation from react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/Presets.ts. Remove all 'worklet' directives, change import from ./NativeRNPulsar to ./NativePulsar. Keep the exact same preset names and structure.

userStories.title: Settings API
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer, I want to configure the haptic engine (enable/disable haptics, manage cache, query support level).
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/Settings.ts importing from ./NativePulsar

Export default Settings object with methods: enableHaptics(state: boolean), enableSound(state: boolean), enableCache(state: boolean), clearCache(), preloadPresets(presetNames: string[]), stopHaptics(), shutDownEngine(), getHapticsSupportLevel(): HapticSupport, forceHapticsSupportLevel(level: HapticSupport), enableImpulseCompositionMode(state: boolean), setRealtimeComposerStrategy(strategy: RealtimeComposerStrategy)
Each method delegates to the corresponding NativePulsar method
API shape matches react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/Settings.ts
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/Settings.ts. Nearly identical, just change the import source and remove the RN prototype caching workaround lines.

userStories.title: PatternComposer hook
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer, I want to compose custom haptic patterns using usePatternComposer with the same Pattern type as React Native.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/usePatternComposer.ts using useCallback and useEffect from @lynx-js/react
Hook accepts optional Pattern argument, calls Pulsar.parsePattern(data) which returns a patternId
play() calls Pulsar.patternPlay(patternId) if patternId is valid
stop() calls Pulsar.patternStop(patternId) if patternId is valid
parse(pattern) calls Pulsar.parsePattern(pattern) and stores the returned patternId in a ref
useEffect cleanup calls Pulsar.patternRelease(patternId) on unmount
Returns { play, stop, parse, isParsed } matching the PatternComposer type
No 'worklet' directives
No dependency on react-native-reanimated or useSharableState — use useRef instead
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/usePatternComposer.ts. Key change: replace useSharableState (Reanimated) with useRef from @lynx-js/react for storing patternId. Remove all 'worklet' directives.

acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/src/index.tsx re-exporting: Presets (default from ./Presets), Settings (default from ./Settings), usePatternComposer (default from ./usePatternComposer)
Re-export types: Pattern, PatternComposer, AdaptivePreset, AdaptivePresetConfig, AdaptiveHaptics from ./types
Re-export enums: HapticSupport, RealtimeComposerStrategy from ./NativePulsar
Do NOT export useRealtimeComposer or useAdaptiveHaptics (deferred to phase 2)
Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/package.json with name lynx-pulsar, @lynx-js/react as peerDependency
Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/tsconfig.json for TypeScript compilation
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/src/index.tsx and react-native/react-native-pulsar/package.json for structure. Adapt dependencies from react-native to @lynx-js/react.

userStories.title: iOS LynxModule bridge
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer on iOS, I need the native module registered so JS calls reach the Swift Pulsar SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: Mirror iOS Swift SDK sources from iOS/Pulsar/Sources/Pulsar/ into lynx/lynx-pulsar/deps/Pulsar/ (same strategy as react-native/react-native-pulsar/deps/Pulsar/)
Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/ios/PulsarLynxModule.h declaring the module interface conforming to LynxModule protocol
Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/ios/PulsarLynxModule.m implementing the module
+name returns @"PulsarModule"
+methodLookup maps all JS method names (play, enableHaptics, hapticSupport, parsePattern, patternPlay, patternStop, patternRelease, etc.) to ObjC selectors
Module holds Pulsar* instance, creates it in init
play: delegates to [[pulsar getPresets] getByName:name] play]
parsePattern: creates PatternComposer from pattern data, stores in NSMutableDictionary registry keyed by pattern ID, returns the ID
patternPlay/patternStop/patternRelease: look up PatternComposer by ID and call play/stop/release
All settings methods delegate to corresponding Pulsar SDK methods
Include registration example comment in header: [globalConfig registerModule:PulsarLynxModule.class]
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/ios/Haptics.mm for the implementation pattern. The logic is nearly identical — just swap TurboModule boilerplate for LynxModule protocol (+name, +methodLookup). Import Lynx/LynxModule.h instead of React headers.

userStories.title: Android LynxModule bridge
userStories.description: As a Lynx app developer on Android, I need the native module registered so JS calls reach the Kotlin Pulsar SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lynx/lynx-pulsar/android/src/main/java/com/swmansion/pulsar/PulsarLynxModule.kt extending LynxModule
Constructor takes Context parameter, initializes Pulsar instance and RealtimeComposer
All public methods annotated with @LynxMethod
play(name: String) delegates to pulsar.getPresets().getByName(name)?.play()
parsePattern(data: ReadableMap): Int parses pattern data, creates PatternComposer, stores in MutableMap<Int, PatternComposer> registry, returns ID
patternPlay/patternStop/patternRelease look up PatternComposer by ID

All settings methods (enableHaptics, enableSound, enableCache, clearCache, preloadPresets, stopHaptics, shutDownEngine, hapticSupport, forceHapticsSupportLevel, enableImpulseCompositionMode, setRealtimeComposerStrategy) delegate to Pulsar SDK
hapticSupport() returns Double mapping from CompatibilityMode enum
Include registration example comment: LynxEnv.inst().registerModule("PulsarModule", PulsarLynxModule::class.java)
Create build.gradle with Lynx SDK dependency and source sets including the Kotlin Pulsar SDK sources
userStories.notes: Reference react-native/react-native-pulsar/android/src/main/java/com/swmansion/pulsar/PulsarModule.kt for the implementation pattern. Key changes: extend LynxModule instead of NativeRNPulsarSpec, use @LynxMethod instead of override, constructor takes Context instead of ReactApplicationContext.
